sample.name: Albert A. Garthwaite Stadium
facts: Multi-sports venue in Conshohocken with a capacity of 3,700, named for a former Lee Tire & Rubber president.
Fully renovated in 2012 with upgrades to the stands, facilities and floodlights.
Home field of the Philadelphia Fight rugby league team.
